title: Concors: Agent Orchestrator
shortDescription: Follow AI agents, review requests and use your terminal from your phone.
fullDescription:
Keep your coding agents within reach. Concors connects your phone to development workspaces on your existing computers and servers.

FOLLOW THE WORK
Read agent conversations, review code changes and follow progress across connected projects.

KEEP THE NEXT STEP MOVING
Answer questions, review tool requests and choose which actions to allow.

YOUR TERMINAL, WITH YOU
Check command output and continue terminal sessions on a connected machine. Browse project files alongside your agents.

YOUR MACHINES AND AI ACCOUNTS
Sign in to Concors and connect your machines from the desktop app at concors.dev. The mobile app uses existing machines; it does not provision or sell machines or AI subscriptions. Keep your machine online and its Concors daemon up to date.

Agent tools and commands run on the connected machine. AI services use the provider and account configured for that agent and may have their own charges. Review the named service and data-sharing request before allowing AI actions.

Free at launch. For people aged 16 and older.

Support: gm@hologram.xyz
Website: https://concors.dev
Privacy: https://concors.dev/privacy
